svg.aria-label: hwcontract catches a WS2812 timing fault

text.style: font-family='JetBrains Mono,Fira Code,ui-monospace,SF Mono,Menlo,Consolas,monospace' font-size='15' font-size='13'

svg.text: hwcontract - MCP session: agent asks why the NeoPixel strip is wrong
LEDs stay dark. Code looks right. What is wrong on the wire?

text.style: font-family='JetBrains Mono,Fira Code,ui-monospace,SF Mono,Menlo,Consolas,monospace' font-size='15' font-weight='bold'

text.tspan: only 50ns from min; nudge toward typ 450

text.style: font-family='JetBrains Mono,Fira Code,ui-monospace,SF Mono,Menlo,Consolas,monospace' font-size='15' font-weight='bold'

svg.text: verdict: FAIL - 2 edges out of spec

text.style: font-family='JetBrains Mono,Fira Code,ui-monospace,SF Mono,Menlo,Consolas,monospace' font-size='15' font-weight='bold'

svg.text: T0H 612ns > 550ns max: every '0' bit decodes as a '1',
so each LED shows the wrong color bits.
RESET 12us < 50us min: the strip never latches; the last
pixels keep the previous frame. That is the dark tail.
Fix: drive the high pulse with a timer, target typ 400ns
for a 0-bit, and hold the line low >= 50us between frames.

text.style: font-family='JetBrains Mono,Fira Code,ui-monospace,SF Mono,Menlo,Consolas,monospace' font-size='15' font-weight='bold'
